_comment: Defaults only: put your own settings in ~/MorningBriefing/voice.local.json (same keys; ref and ref_text can be full paths to your own WAV and transcript), so updates never clash. Mac recording voice (Fish Audio S2-Pro on MLX). ref = the reference clip Fish copies (engine/mac/<ref>.wav), ref_text = its transcript (engine/mac/<ref_text>.txt). To use a different voice, drop a 10-30 s WAV and its exact transcript in engine/mac/ and change these two names. models are tried in order.
